conclusion: All four frozen observations have spectral signature (-,+,+). Separately, the chosen bounded PCHIP descriptor retains that signature and has no zero crossing on the observed convex hull. This is an interpolant property, not evidence at unobserved scales, a continuous proof, a bifurcation inference, a device prediction or an experimental conclusion.
direction_interpretation: At each of the four frozen observations, the negative eigenvector is confined, in the normalized coordinate chart, to lateral bob translation y plus roll about x. The orthogonal y-roll combination and rotation about y are positive at those same four points.

interpolant.interpretation: descriptive PCHIP visualization only; not evaluated model evidence between observations

observed.interpretation: directly extracted from four hash-bound frozen cards

interpretation_limit: four hash-bound frozen observations plus a descriptive no-extrapolation PCHIP visualization; no unobserved-scale model evidence, continuous proof, device stability, contact-law validation or qualification
